name: Nature & Hiking
tagline: Forests, waterfalls and summits in honest daylight.
description: Landscape-rich portraits for nature lovers: old-growth forest trails, waterfalls, sunrise summits, alpine lakes, autumn foliage, coastal cliffs, wildflower meadows, desert arches and rainforest ferns. Practical outdoor gear and big, beautiful scenery.
